en-US.summary: Voice control for your personal assistant app.
examplePhrases: Alexa, tell personal assistant to add milk to my grocery list
Alexa, ask personal assistant what is on my shopping list
en-US.name: Personal Assistant
en-US.description: Lets you manage your grocery and shopping lists by voice, and ask your personal assistant anything you'd normally type in the app — todos, reminders, calendar, and more. Backed by your own PersonalAssistant app.

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Personal skill for the device owner. Say 'add milk to my grocery list', 'what's on my shopping list', or any request your app assistant handles.
